fix.objective: Close the local scheduled-worker-to-app review gap so worker-created evidence reaches Today/Alerts/Journal without recurring whole-workspace export/import replacement.
fix.root_cause: Worker SQLite WAL and web IndexedDB are independent durable workspaces; their only bridge is whole-backup file transfer and revision-gated workspace replacement.
fix.smallest_coherent_repair: Add deterministic owner-visible local worker update handoff with revision/content identity and conflict protection, preserving newer app decisions/notes; surface pending/available/stale/recovered status. Require neither hosted sync nor external email.
acceptance_criteria: Run local worker with UI closed; later app open presents new evaluation/alert with exact recipe version, evaluation identity, source/date/provenance and condition context.
Handoff is deterministic/idempotent; replay creates no duplicates and never substitutes current recipe/snapshot state for captured evidence.
New app decisions/amendments/notes survive worker update; conflicts are explicit and a recovery copy is available.
Pending, available, stale, partial, missed, conflict and restored states are owner-visible; no schedule-installed, email-delivered or always-on claim is inferred.
CSV adjustment/source honesty, SQLite durability, leases/retries/catch-up, alert-vs-delivery, complete backup/recovery and current Golden UI quality remain covered.
explicit_non_goals: No hosted deployment or multi-user service

final_qualification_after_fix: Configure owner path with watchlist, recipe/Eye, authorized adjusted completed US daily CSV and benchmark inputs.
Run worker with app closed for normal session, outage/retry, duplicate replay, corrected input and bounded catch-up; verify IDs and missed/partial states.
Open app and verify new worker change appears without whole-workspace replacement; record decision/amendment/outcome bound to historical evaluation/recipe.
Exercise simultaneous/newer app edits, stale/malformed bundle, interrupted handoff, backup-before-import and isolated restore.
Verify local awake-machine/scheduler boundary and optional SMTP intent/provider acceptance/confirmed receipt without external delivery claims.
Run locked install, tests/boundaries/audit, required exports/browser/accessibility/recovery/operations and exact-base release evidence.
